questions.prompt: Which event introduces the situation in Wren's One-Object Pocket?
choices: Rain began to fall over Fern's garden, where ten moonberries lay drying on a cloth. Fern watched the drops. The berries had to reach Hollow Oak before they were soaked.

Rain drummed outside while Fern opened the dry leaf bundle. She counted every moonberry into her bowl. All ten had reached Hollow Oak together.
